name: Promote RC to stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }}
      rc_sha: ${{ steps.get-sha.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set stable tag
        id: set-stable
        run: |
          rc="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable="${rc/-rc[0-9]*/}"
          echo "stable_tag=$stable" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Verify RC tag exists
        run: |
          if ! git rev-parse "${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RC tag ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify stable tag does not exist
        run: |
          if git rev-parse "${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stable tag ${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }} already exists."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Get RC commit SHA
        id: get-sha
        run: |
          sha=$(git rev-parse "${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}")
          echo "sha=$sha" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create stable tag
        run: |
          git tag ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_sha }}
          git push origin ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}

      - name: Docker login
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: docker.io
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          for image in grafana/beyla grafana/beyla-k8s-cache; do
            docker buildx imagetools create --push --tag "$image:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" "$image:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          done

      - name: Draft release notes
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          config-name: release-drafter.yml
          tag: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          publish: false
        id: draft

      - name: Create stable release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          release_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          body: ${{ steps.draft.outputs.body }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        id: create

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Download RC release assets
        run: |
